ITEM 1 | Dark reddish-brown oval beans, glossy and smooth-skinned, about 1.5-2 cm long, scattered across the center of the plate with some slightly wrinkled skins; roughly 20 pieces covering about 25% of the plate surface, piled 1-1.5 cm high in places | 85
ITEM 2 | Pale green cucumber slices, half-moon and wedge pieces about 4-6 cm long and 1 cm thick, firm, moist-looking skin with darker green rind edges, scattered around the plate covering about 20% of the surface, lying flat to slightly raised | 45
ITEM 3 | Fresh dark green spinach-type leaves, flat and crinkled, lying as a bed under the beans and cucumber, covering about 30% of the plate, less than 0.5 cm thick, slightly moist with no dressing sheen visible | 25
ITEM 4 | Pale light green lettuce-type leaf, ruffled edges, one cluster at the right edge of the plate covering about 5% of the surface, about 0.3 cm thick | 8
ITEM 5 | Thin shreds of pale yellow and orange vegetable (carrot-like strands) and pale noodle-like strands on a separate plate at the lower left, not on the main plate; visible sheen, slightly oily | 30
